hypotheses.T0_trace_target_is_exact: The final Layer-11-attention target trivially self-reconstructs to maximum absolute error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.T1_layer10_residual_contains_same_axis_h: After Layer-10 MLP, scalar same-axis maps reach median high-degree-hub R2 at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T2_midlayer_contains_same_axis_hubs: After Layer-6 MLP, scalar same-axis maps reach median high-degree-hub R2 at least 0.50 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_pair_grammar_is_present_before_final_: After Layer-10 MLP, scalar same-edge maps reach median selected-edge R2 at least 0.70 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_late_coordinates_do_not_require_rotat: At Layer-10 MLP, a full 32-by-32 affine map improves median axis R2 over scalar same-axis maps by at most 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_readability_generally_increases_with_: For every corpus, best half-block scalar edge R2 has Spearman correlation at least 0.70 with stage depth.
hypotheses.T6_depth_profile_transfers_ood: The FineWeb scalar-edge-R2 stage profile has Spearman correlation at least 0.85 with both OOD profiles.
